metadata.data_notice: Values are XBRL facts from each issuer's Form 10-K filings as returned by the SEC EDGAR company facts API (or, where noted, read from the filing's XBRL instance). The XBRL tag and accession number of every value are in the record. Line-item names are this skill's labels; the tag is the precise definition. Not investment advice.
metadata.description: 20 issuers, up to 4 fiscal years and 21 line items each, built by scripts/reported_financials.py. facts_sha256 is the SHA-256 of a record's fiscal years and values (reported_financials.record_sha256).
metadata.basis: Annual figures as reported on Form 10-K under US GAAP, read from SEC XBRL company facts. Each value is the one the most recent Form 10-K reports for that fiscal year, so a prior year can differ from what was first reported; restated_from then gives the first-reported value. Amounts are in USD millions unless line_items says otherwise. Growth, margins and free cash flow are computed in Python from these values and rounded half-up to two decimals; one is left out, with the reason under not_computed, when an input is missing or when its inputs come from different filings and one was restated. A line item under not_tagged is one the company does not report under any of the standard tags this skill reads; it is not zero.
